items.title: Latest Windows release health and servicing signals
items.summary: Microsoft Windows Release Health has been refreshed with current servicing milestones, known issues, resolved issues, and safeguards.
items.impact: Use Release Health as a deployment gate before updating enterprise images, servicing rings, or ConfigMgr task sequences.

items.title: Latest Intune service changes
items.summary: Microsoft Intune What's New has been refreshed. Review the latest service release for Windows management, app, security, enrollment, and administration changes.
items.impact: Intune service changes can affect policy, apps, security configuration, enrollment, and support workflows.

items.title: Latest Windows Autopilot provisioning signals
items.summary: Microsoft Autopilot documentation has been refreshed for provisioning and device-preparation changes.
items.impact: Provisioning behavior, ESP, app dependencies, enrollment, and troubleshooting procedures can change as the cloud service evolves.

items.title: Latest Configuration Manager current-branch signals
items.summary: Microsoft ConfigMgr release documentation has been refreshed for current-branch changes, fixes, and dependency updates.
items.impact: Validate new releases against task sequences, boot images, clients, site dependencies, ADK support, and Windows servicing.

items.title: Defender Antivirus platform 4.18.26080.3 tracked
items.summary: Microsoft's Defender release notes have been refreshed with current Endpoint and Antivirus platform, engine, and security intelligence information.
items.impact: OSD and offline provisioning need more than definition currency. Platform and engine versions are separate lifecycle signals.

items.title: Latest Windows 365 platform signals
items.summary: Microsoft Windows 365 documentation has been refreshed for Cloud PC provisioning, management, and platform changes.
items.impact: Cloud PCs share endpoint architecture concerns with physical Windows devices: identity, policy, apps, security, and observability.
